Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "ui 席 1" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

No maintainer ruling on this card. Triage direction (on the card), verbatim: 「⛔ It uses one evaluator (ADR-0032): the console normalises a bare string to the CEL envelope at the same point the server does, with no legacy path.」 Governing text: ADR-0032 and the spec's definition of a bare string as CEL shorthand (protocol is the baseline: code aligns to spec).

### PM mechanism assumptions (measured read-only on `origin/main` `57c51aab4d`; re-measure)

- `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/ExpressionEvaluator.ts` `evaluateCondition` (~341) routes only an explicit `{dialect:'cel'}` envelope to CEL (~361–369, comment "Bare strings and `${…}` templates stay on the legacy path"); a bare string goes to `evaluateExpression` (~404–410).
- Nav `visible` reaches it through `evaluateNavigationVisibility` / `evaluateVisibility` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx` ~597/668/681; a fault withholds the entry for everyone); page `visibleWhen` through `ui/packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` `VISIBILITY_SHOW_KEYS` (~369) and `evaluateCondition` (~1451/1472/1588).
- `core/src/evaluator/predicateInput.ts` `toPredicateInput` (~179) wraps bare strings with `wrapIfBare` into the legacy `${}` form; the server-side normaliser is `packages/formula/src/normalize.ts` `normalizeExpression` (~33). Find the single point where the console should apply the same normalisation and say in the PR body why it is that point.
- Risk to measure first: how many authored bare-string predicates in this repository (examples, `ui/examples`, app metadata, tests) are legacy-grammar only (do not parse as CEL). Report the count with the grep. If they are fixable in this diff, fix them; if a published sample or the server itself depends on the legacy reading, stop and report `needs_decision` (four-axis analysis, SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉).

### Pin sweep (this flips a public reading; both sentences binding)

① grep 错误码与错误消息全仓扫同语义 pin,一轮翻完,不只改本包。
② 翻转后的 pin 必须承重:断言新语义的实质(行数、译文、状态码),不是旧断言已删。

Tests that pin the "bare strings stay legacy" back-compat window are the expected flips; a true illegal-shape refusal is kept verbatim.

### Scope

- File surface: `ExpressionEvaluator.ts`, `predicateInput.ts`, `ExpressionProvider.tsx`, `SchemaRenderer.tsx` / `react/src/hooks/useExpression.ts` only as measured, tests beside, authored predicates the measurement names, changeset. ⛔ `packages/spec/**`, ⛔ `packages/formula/**` (read only).
- Acceptance: a nav item `visible` and a page `visibleWhen` written as bare CEL strings (shapes taken from the spec's own examples) evaluate on CEL in the console (tests); an ablation restoring the legacy route turns them red.
- Tier: no path-derived mandate ⇒ `TIER_DEFAULT`; effort `high` (p2, M, wide pin sweep). `Clause-②: no` (aligns the runtime to the declared spec). If your measurement shows legacy-only syntax that stops working, that is a narrowing: say so in the report; the seat owes a contract-review-tier review before the queue. `Metadata-protocol: none` unless you measure otherwise.
